deadline.value: December 18 (no year printed; inferred 2026). Letters due January 8. Pages are partly stale: the admissions page (updated 09/29/2026) still says "Fall 2026", and the FAQ shows the previous cycle (December 14th, 2025). Confirm with admissions@physics.utah.edu
deadline.quote: The online application, including uploads of all supporting documents through that portal, must be submitted December 18th for your application to be considered. | Recommendation letters are due by January 8th.

also.quote: All student-uploaded applications and materials must be submitted by December 14th, 2025.

gre_subject.quote: For all students, general and physics subject GRE scores are optional - you are welcome to submit them if you think it will strengthen your application. Omission of GRE scores will not be penalized.

supervisor.value: No need to find a PhD research advisor first; show familiarity with department research
supervisor.quote: Do I need to find a PhD research advisor first? | No. However, your research interests should align with our research offerings.

funding.value: All students admitted to the PhD track are offered a teaching assistantship in the offer letter; eligible PhD students get the Tuition Benefit (tuition + health insurance); RA possible after joining a group
funding.quote: All students admitted to the Ph.D. track are offered a Teaching Assistantship, which is noted in the departmental offer letter.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's required before joining; master's awarded as a milestone en route to the PhD
entry_route.quote: Prior to joining the program, admitted students must have received a bachelor's degree from an accredited institute, college, or university.

also.quote: Our graduate program is primarily available to students seeking a PhD to which they can be awarded their Master's as a milestone on the way to their PhD.

app_fee.value: USD 65 for international applicants (USD 55 domestic); non-refundable
app_fee.quote: The fee is $55 for Domestic applicants, $65 for International applicants on a visa or in need of a visa.

also.quote: The graduate program application includes an application fee ($55 for domestic students; $65 for international students).

fee_waiver.value: Department grants a limited number of waiver codes via a request form (no citizenship restriction stated, no guarantee). Request deadline Nov 13 per the current admissions page (other pages still show Nov 16, 2025)
fee_waiver.quote: We can grant a limited number of application fee waivers; if you would like to apply for a waiver, please complete this fee waiver request form.

also.quote: Fee Waiver Request Form - deadline Nov 13th

gre_general.quote: For all students, general and physics subject GRE scores are optional - you are welcome to submit them if you think it will strengthen your application. Omission of GRE scores will not be penalized.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 (or 4.5 on the new 6-point scale); IELTS 6.5; Duolingo 110. Official scores required; Versant spoken test and ITA workshop after admission
toefl_min.quote: iBT/TOEFL 80/120 or higher | iBT/TOEFL 4.5/6 or higher | IELTS 6.5 or higher | Duolingo 110 or higher

english_waiver.value: Exemption is by citizenship of listed native-English countries only; India is not on the list, and an English-medium degree does not count (only a U.S. regionally accredited degree within two years does)
english_waiver.quote: If you are a native English speaking citizen of the following countries, you will not need to submit proof of English proficiency. | Citizens of a country not listed below will still need to prove English proficiency through one of our approved means, even if the medium of academic instruction is English. | Grenada Guyana Ireland Jamaica Kenya | associate, bachelor’s, master’s or doctoral degrees must be earned from a regionally-accredited U.S. college or university

notes: Interviews precede offers. International admits must take the Versant spoken English test and attend the ITA workshop. Department pages mix cycle years; verify dates before applying.
